p: Enquire: Not that the king was touched with repentance of his sins and so sought God, as did Hezekiah when he sent for Isaiah, 2Ki 19:1, Isa 37:2 but because the prophet might pray to God to take this present plague away, as Pharaoh sought Moses Ex 9:28.
turn back the weapons of war: That is, from your enemies to destroy yourselves.
way of life: By yielding yourselves to Nebuchadnezzar.
prize: As a thing recovered from extreme danger, Jer 37:2,39:18,45:5.
in the morning: Be diligent to do justice.
O inhabitant of the valley: Meaning, Jerusalem which was built part on the hill and part in the valley and was compassed about with mountains.
in its forest: That is, in the houses of it, which stood as thick as trees in the forest.
